caseNameFull: American Packing Company v. Paul Luketa
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Alpheus Byers for plaintiff in error. Mr. Benjamin S. Ohnick for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
